name: scrap-dashboard-suite
description: Sistema MES SCRAP Dashboard Industrial - Frontend & Backend Suite con integración a SQL Server (SSMS)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.actualizar: npm run install:all && npm run build
scripts.todo: npm run build && npm run dev
scripts.start: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,green" "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run preview --prefix frontend"
